processing_steps.method: charging raw materials into alumina crucible
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Iron powder (700 g) and ferrous oxalate (FeC2O4·H2O, 1.575 g) were placed in an alumina crucible and then placed in a tubular furnace for heating.

processing_steps.method: heating in tubular furnace to 1873 K and holding
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: When the tubular furnace was heated to 1873 K, kept for 40 min, then the deoxidizer was added.
225 g of ferromanganese was added and kept for 20 min; the operating steps and the amount of ferromanganese added in the three groups were consistent.

processing_steps.method: addition of aluminum particles wrapped in pure iron sheet
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: 48 g of aluminum particles (third group, corresponding to 3# sample) were added wrapped in pure iron sheet and kept for 60 min.
Finally, the sample was cooled to room temperature in a tubular furnace (as-cast furnace-cooled state).

structures.overall_structure: As-cast Fe-15Mn-5Al-C low-density steel (3#, Al = 4.695%) containing single AlN, MnS, TiN and Al2O3 inclusions plus Al2O3-MnS, AlN-MnS and TiN-MnS composite inclusions; Al2O3-AlN-MnS composite inclusions were not observed in the 3# sample.

phases_present.morphology: single and multiple particles with polyhedral structures
octahedral inclusions with a size of ≈10 μm

phases_present.crystal_structure: cubic (a=b=c=4.242 Å; printed with MnS subscripts in source Table 6)
phases_present.morphology: elongated shapes with lengths higher than 30 μm
located at the bottom of the Al2O3-MnS composite inclusion, with MnS located above
Al2O3 inclusion at the bottom and MnS inclusion above the Al2O3 inclusion
morphology is the shape of a cigarette bag
binding between MnS and AlN inclusions is very tight; the connection is not physical

phase_interfaces.coherence: 2D lattice mismatch degree 8.94% (moderate effective zone); binding between MnS and AlN is very tight and not physical

defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Al2O3, AlN, and TiN could provide nucleation sites for MnS; Al2O3 could also provide heterogeneous nucleation sites for AlN (mismatch degrees: Al2O3/MnS 8.41%, AlN/MnS 8.94%, TiN/MnS 11.65%, AlN/Al2O3 11.66%).

interfaces.phase_evolution: 3# solidification route: L → L + BCC → L + BCC + FCC → BCC + FCC → FCC; the route passes through the BCC phase and the FCC region is narrowed.
interfaces.interface_notes: Al2O3-AlN-MnS composite inclusions were not observed in the 3# sample; Al2O3 is at the bottom and MnS above in the Al2O3-MnS composite; TiN-MnS has a cigarette-bag shape; AlN-MnS binding is tight and not physical.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Calculated with FactSage 8.2 for the Fe-C-Si-Mn-P-S-Al-O-N-Ti system

characterization_methods.technique: chemical analysis (carbon-sulfur analyzer for T.O, T.N, C, S; inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry for Al, Si, Ti, Mn, P)
characterization_methods.purpose: detect the chemical composition of the experimental steels

characterization_methods.technique: metallographic preparation (electric discharge wire-cutting; metallographic sandpaper; metallographic polishing paste to mirror surface)
characterization_methods.purpose: prepare solid steel sample surfaces for inclusion observation

characterization_methods.technique: nonaqueous solvent electrolytic separation followed by magnet separation and collection on a carbon strip
characterization_methods.purpose: prepare inclusion powder for morphology and type observation

characterization_methods.technique: field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FE-SEM) with energy dispersive spectrometer (EDS)
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: ZEISS ΣIGMA HD FE-SEM; Oxford-X-Max 50 mm² EDS
characterization_methods.purpose: observe morphology and type of inclusions in the 3# sample
characterization_methods.key_findings: 3# contains: AlN (polyhedral single/clustered); MnS (octahedral, ≈10 μm); TiN (elongated, lengths >30 μm); Al2O3-MnS (Al2O3 bottom, MnS above); TiN-MnS (cigarette-bag shape); AlN-MnS (very tight, non-physical binding).

characterization_methods.purpose: measure the size, type, and number of inclusions
characterization_methods.key_findings: 3# inclusion size distribution: 1-5 μm 48.2%, 5-10 μm 46.9%, >10 μm 4.9% of the total number.

computational_details.simulation_method: CALPHAD phase diagram calculation (FactSage 8.2 phase diagram module)
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: Computed 3# liquidus 1796 K and solidus 1532 K; computed solidification route L → L+BCC → L+BCC+FCC → BCC+FCC → FCC; computed precipitation solidification fractions AlN 0.51, TiN 0.94, MnS 0.85.

analytical_models.equation_role: calculate element contents at the solidification front (Equations 8-10)
analytical_models.model_note: Uses equilibrium distribution coefficients k and diffusion coefficients D from Table 5 (Al, N, Mn, S, Ti).

analytical_models.equation_role: assess heterogeneous nucleation effectiveness of substrates (Equation 23)
analytical_models.model_note: Lattice parameters from Table 6 (AlN, MnS, Al2O3, TiN).

analytical_models.model_name: Thermodynamic equilibrium calculations for inclusion precipitation
analytical_models.equation_role: compute theoretical concentration products and precipitation solidification fractions for AlN, TiN, and MnS
analytical_models.model_note: Uses first/second-order interaction coefficients from Table 4 at 1873 K and equilibrium/distribution coefficients from Table 5.

unmapped_findings: Measured chemical composition of 3# sample (mass%): C 0.41, Si 0.31, Mn 14.83, Al 4.695, N 0.0021, P 0.045, S 0.016, O 0.0013, Ti 0.0060, Fe Bal. (Table 2). [b0020, b0025, b0026]
In the 3# sample, Al2O3-AlN-MnS composite inclusions were not observed (they exist in 1# and 2# samples). [b0032]
3# inclusion size distribution: 1-5 μm 48.2%, 5-10 μm 46.9%, and >10 μm 4.9% of the total number. [b0033, figure_005]
From Figure 4 (no printed data labels), the AlN segment grows to about 60% of the 3# bar and the Al2O3 segment shrinks to a thin sliver; these are approximate visual readings only. [figure_004]

AlN precipitation solidification fraction for 3# is 0.51 (delayed from 0.22 at 3% Al to 0.51 at 5% Al); N solubility significantly decreased in 3#, delaying AlN precipitation via combined Al and N action. [b0079, b0081]

TiN precipitation solidification fraction for 3# is 0.94; MnS precipitation solidification fraction for 3# is 0.85. The S content in 3# is higher than in 1# and 2#, yet MnS precipitation is still delayed. [b0090, b0103, b0105]
